strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout via cartTotal/bulkDiscount in src/cart.js: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items (summed quantities), SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, goods floored at $0, other codes refused), and $4.99 shipping below $50 of discounted goods (free at/above, empty cart costs 0). Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule and its boundaries through the public functions.
inScope: Bulk discount threshold and quantity summing
SAVE5 ordering, $0 floor, refusal of other codes
Shipping threshold after discounts and empty cart
outOfScope: UI/checkout pages (none exist in the repo)
assumptions: Coupon codes match exactly (case-sensitive): 'save5' is another code and is refused.
Checkout total = discounted goods + shipping, rounded to cents, as cartTotal returns.
Reading the code, bulkDiscount uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items gets no discount; tests asserting AC1 at the boundary are expected to fail and will be reported as a defect.
`coupon in COUPONS` accepts inherited names like 'toString'; the refusal test for it is expected to fail and will be reported.

risks.mitigation: TC1 asserts exactly 10 items is discounted; TC3 asserts 9 is not

risks.description: Coupon applied before bulk discount, or goods going negative
risks.mitigation: TC4 picks values where the order changes the total; TC5 checks the floor

risks.description: Unknown codes accepted via prototype keys, yielding NaN totals

risks.mitigation: TC9/TC11 use carts whose discount pushes goods below $50

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Exactly 10 items get no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1 says 10 or more items get 10% off; bulkDiscount in src/cart.js uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart with exactly 10 items isn't discounted.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:6,quantity:10}]) returns 60, expected 54 (test is it.fails and passes as expected failure)

defects.title: Coupon validation accepts inherited property names
defects.description: AC2 says any code other than SAVE5 is refused; `coupon in COUPONS` passes for 'toString' etc., so no error is thrown and the total becomes invalid.
defects.evidence: cartTotal(items,{coupon:'toString'}) does not throw (test is it.fails and passes as expected failure)
